Flight Plan

From first call to final data, three stages.

Every project is hands-on managed by our founder, from booking through delivery.

STAGE 01

Book & Plan

We scope the site, confirm airspace and schedule the flight window around weather and access constraints.

STAGE 02

Fly & Capture

Certified RPC pilots fly a compliant, insured mission — mapping, inspecting or filming exactly what you need.

STAGE 03

Process & Deliver

Raw data is processed into orthomosaics, reports or edited media, and delivered ready for your workflow.

Founder-Led

RPC + BVLOS certified — most local operators are limited to line of sight.

Maziya Drones (PTY) LTD is a Pietermaritzburg-based commercial drone operator bridging complex aerial operations with actionable ground insight for infrastructure, telecom, construction and agricultural clients.

BVLOS certification lets us legally cover large or remote sites — pipelines, farms, tower networks, transmission corridors — in fewer flights and faster turnaround than VLOS-only competitors can offer.
